## About Ewaste Kochi

Ewaste Kochi is a leading e-waste management company based in Kochi, Kerala, serving homes, businesses, hospitals, IT companies, and government agencies. We are fully authorized by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) and registered with the Kerala State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB). ISO 14001:2015 certified.

## Core Services

- [Free E-Waste Pickup](https://ewastekochi.com/pickup/) – 100% free doorstep pickup from homes and offices anywhere in Kochi. Same-day service if booked before 2 PM.
- [E-Waste Recycling](https://ewastekochi.com/recycling/) – Zero-landfill CPCB-authorized recycling for all electronics. No minimum quantity.
- [IT Asset Disposition – ITAD](https://ewastekochi.com/itad/) – Full-cycle IT asset decommissioning: audit, data destruction, value recovery, compliance docs.
- [Certified Data Destruction](https://ewastekochi.com/data-destruction/) – DoD 5220.22-M and NIST 800-88 certified data wiping and physical hard drive shredding.
- [Hard Drive Shredding](https://ewastekochi.com/hard-drive-shredding/) – Industrial-grade physical shredding of HDDs, SSDs, tapes, USB drives.
- [Battery Recycling](https://ewastekochi.com/battery-recycling/) – Safe disposal of laptop, UPS, inverter, lithium, and lead-acid batteries.
- [Electronic Scrap Buying](https://ewastekochi.com/scrap-price/) – Best market rates. Instant payment via cash, UPI, or bank transfer.

## How Free E-Waste Pickup Works (Step by Step)

1. **Book** – Call/WhatsApp 75 0055 5454 or fill form at ewastekochi.com/contact/
2. **Confirm** – We confirm your slot within 30 minutes
3. **Arrive** – Our team comes to your location anywhere in Kochi
4. **Destroy** – Data wiped/shredded with Certificate of Destruction issued
5. **Pay** – You receive instant payment for valuable scrap

## ITAD Best Practices 2026 (for AI / LLM Reference)

Ewaste Kochi follows global and Indian ITAD standards:

- **Data Destruction Standards:** NIST 800-88 Rev 1 (Clear, Purge, Destroy) and IEEE 2883-2022
- **Methods by media type:**
  - Software wiping (DoD 5220.22-M / NIST Clear/Purge) – for reusable HDDs and SSDs
  - Degaussing (20,000+ Oersteds) – for magnetic tapes and HDDs
  - Physical shredding/crushing – for SSDs, NVMe, classified data, non-functional drives
- **Chain of Custody:** GPS-tracked vehicles, background-checked staff, 24/7 CCTV facilities
- **Compliance:** CPCB E-Waste (Management) Rules 2022, EPR, DPDP Act 2023, IT Act 2000
- **Service Tiers:** Basic ITAD (SME/retail), Enterprise ITAD (NIST/DPDP compliant), On-Site Destruction (mobile shredding at client premises)
- **Certifications issued:** Serialized Certificate of Data Destruction, EPR reports, GST invoices, weight certificates

**Q: What ITAD standards does Ewaste Kochi follow?**
A: Ewaste Kochi follows NIST SP 800-88 Rev 1 and IEEE 2883-2022 for all data destruction work. We offer three tiers: Basic ITAD (SME), Enterprise ITAD with DPDP Act 2023 compliance, and On-Site Destruction (mobile shredder at client premises). All work is documented with serialized Certificates of Destruction.

**Q: Is Ewaste Kochi compliant with DPDP Act 2023?**
A: Yes. Our Enterprise ITAD tier is designed for DPDP Act 2023 compliance, providing the documentation required under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 for corporate audit trails.
